📺 The Good Wife (2009–2016)

The Good Wife follows Alicia Florrick, a devoted wife and mother whose life is turned upside down when her husband, Peter Florrick, a powerful Chicago politician, becomes involved in a shocking political and sexual scandal that leads to his imprisonment. After spending years supporting her husband’s career and raising their children, Alicia is forced to rebuild her life by returning to work as an attorney at a prestigious Chicago law firm. As she navigates complicated courtroom battles, political corruption, workplace rivalries, and difficult personal relationships, Alicia gradually transforms from a woman living in her husband’s shadow into a confident and independent lawyer. Alongside her colleagues Will Gardner, Diane Lockhart, and Kalinda Sharma, she faces challenging legal cases and unexpected betrayals while balancing her responsibilities as a mother. Starring Julianna Margulies, Christine Baranski, Josh Charles, Archie Panjabi, and Chris Noth, the series delivers gripping legal drama, emotional storytelling, and unforgettable moments about ambition, loyalty, betrayal, justice, and personal strength.

🎭 Genre: Legal Drama • Crime • Political Drama • Mystery

⭐ IMDb: 8.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Robert King & Michelle King

📺 Seasons: 7 • 156 Episodes

📚 Spin-Off: The Good Fight (2017–2022)

🏆 Awards: Winner of 5 Primetime Emmy Awards, including two Outstanding Lead Actress awards for Julianna Margulies.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Paramount+, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or purchase availability in the United States.
